name: Stage 11: Järna to Vattgruvan
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 11, Järna to Vattgruvan.
utilities: Järna station has commuter rail, buses, and parking about 600 m from the Rönnvägen/Tavestaskolan stage start. Buses 784/785 can also shorten the start approach when they fit the schedule.

Järna has the safest resupply before starting, including ICA, Coop, Pressbyrån, cafes, restaurants, pharmacy/fuel context around the station and Storgatan, but do not assume an all-hours public toilet; a hiker report says even station/Preem/Coop/bakery toilets were difficult early in the morning and ICA helped when asked.

Järna station commuter parking has been reported as 24 h only, and Tavestaskolan/Järna IP parking is conditional with overnight restrictions reported in 2025, including a 00-06 ban report. Check current signs before leaving a car.

Vattgruvsmossen/Vattgruvan has road access and parking at the stage end; the stage steward notes up to 72 h parking, while Länsstyrelsen says the visitor parking/access road has been improved but still has rough sections in places.

The Vattgruvan end is not a rail station and has no equally clean public-transport exit. For a transit-friendly finish, continue via stage 12 and the 12:1 connector toward Mölnbo, or arrange pickup/taxi.

Naturkartan/OSM/Vindskyddskartan support a toilet at Vattgruvsmossen parking and a 2026-04-26 trail comment also reports a toilet at the end, but Länsstyrelsen's visitor-service list is less explicit. Treat it as likely, not guaranteed, until field-checked.
Almviks Gård side services and an OSM-mapped water point north/east of Vattgruvan are off-route and opening/field-verification dependent; do not present them as Stage 11 core utilities.
waterSources: Official spring about 5 km west of Järna; natural and untested, so treat/filter.
Recent official-page comments conflict: the spring was reported dry on 2024-09-07, flowing on 2024-10-19, and fresh on 2025-05-01. Carry backup, especially in dry periods.
Mellanbygget is a good tent/rest spot but explicitly has no water. Do not confuse Vattgruvan/Stora Kobäcken mining or lake water with potable water.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Officially 9 km and medium difficulty; the official page was checked as modified 2025-11-18 and showed no current fault reports. Naturkartan and OSM also list 9 km, Äventyrligare gives 8.92 km, and AllTrails gives about 9.2 km with roughly 320 m ascent and a 2.5-3 hour typical pace. The walking is often experienced as easy in dry conditions, but rocky/hilly forest and mine-hole hazards justify the medium label.

For route drawing, use the official Järna-to-Vattgruvan identity, but beware source quirks: OSM relation 2441745 has correct from/to tags yet reversed member order, Naturkartan snaps the Järna start to the Stage 10/11 join about 42 m from the official coordinate, and Topo GPS route 203163 continues beyond Vattgruvan into stages 12 and 12:1. The extracted official full-GPX segment measures about 8.51 km while OSM raw members measure about 9.01 km; keep official 9 km as the planning distance.

Do not draw Järna station access as Stage 11; the station/parking is about 600 m from the Rönnvägen/Tavestaskolan stage start. Likewise, do not include Stora Kobäcken in Stage 11; it is a Stage 12 continuation about 200-300 m past Vattgruvan.

Sjuenda Kronopark and the Järna/Vattgruvan mining landscape contain over 200 old mine holes across a roughly 5 km historic ore field, many unprotected. Stay on marked trail unless you are deliberately visiting signed mine features, and keep children/dogs close.

Mining around Järna/Vattgruvan dates from the 1600s into the late 1800s, with named features including Tunnelgruvan, Jungfrugruvan, Storgruvan, Mossgruvan, Kruthuset, and the deep Vattgruvan shafts. Treat all remains as protected look-but-do-not-disturb heritage.

Do not enter shafts, climb around openings, move stones, dig, carve, or disturb heritage features. Vattgruvan's deepest shaft is described as going more than 100 m diagonally downward, and mine-hole hazards are worse in snow, leaf cover, low light, or with children/dogs.

Current official and community comments in 2025-2026 describe the stage as well marked, beautiful, and passable, while Friluftsfrämjandet and older reviews noted Tunnelgruvan could be too wet or partly flooded to enter safely.
Vattgruvsmossen reserve rules include dogs leashed, fires only at designated places, no damage to vegetation/dead wood, and no camping more than two consecutive nights in the same place.
Vattgruvsmossen and nearby bog/boardwalk terrain can be wet and rooty; waterproof shoes are sensible, especially after rain or in spring/autumn.
No current official fault report was found for Stage 11 during the 2026-04-28 pass; the latest checked official comment from 2026-04-26 reported the route well marked and easy to follow.

Stora Kobäcken shelter/fireplace/toilet/natural-water context is about 200-300 m beyond the stage end on stage 12. It is important for overnight planning, but should be shown as an adjacent continuation facility; recent field reports mention recent renovation, good tent/hammock options, flat tent space, blueberries, stony ground near the shelter, and no guaranteed wood.
Mats Wenner's long-distance account calls stages 11 and 12 personal favorites, and multiple trip reports highlight the mine history as the stage's standout feature.
During hunting season, especially around the large moose hunt from 8 October, watch for active-hunting signs, many parked cars, or local notices and choose another area if hunting seems active.
Wolf presence has been noted in the wider Mölnbo/Sjundareviret context. This is not a specific danger alert, but it reinforces keeping dogs leashed and securing food if overnighting on continuations.

facilities.name: Järna station access
facilities.description: Commuter rail and bus access about 600 m from the Rönnvägen stage start; official access commonly routes Stockholm City via Södertälje hamn to Järna. Check current SL service.

facilities.name: Järna / Rönnvägen stage start
facilities.description: Official stage start near Rönnvägen/Tavestaskolan after the short walk from Järna station.

facilities.name: Rönnvägen/Tavestaskolan bus access
facilities.description: Start-area bus access for routes such as 784/785 when service is running, reducing the walk from Järna station.

facilities.name: Järna start-area parking
facilities.description: Start-nearby parking cluster. Treat as conditional: station parking is reported 24 h and Tavestaskolan/Järna IP is mainly weekend/school-holiday context with overnight restrictions, including 00-06 restrictions, reported in 2025.

facilities.name: Järna town resupply
facilities.description: Nearby grocery, cafe, pharmacy, and fuel options in Järna. Toilet access is not guaranteed; a 2024 hiker comment says ICA helped when asked after other morning options were difficult.

facilities.name: Coop Järna resupply
facilities.description: Additional start-area grocery option near Järna station. Opening-hour-dependent and not a guaranteed toilet.

facilities.name: Preem Järna service caveat
facilities.description: Fuel/convenience near the start, but not a public toilet guarantee; a 2024 hiker comment specifically failed to find morning toilet access here.

facilities.name: Järna toilet caveat
facilities.description: Planning warning, not a service point: do not rely on station or shop toilets outside opening/customer access. Use confirmed facilities before arrival if starting early.

facilities.name: Stage 11 geometry/source caveat
facilities.description: Official start and OSM/Naturkartan Stage 10/11 join differ by about 42 m; OSM relation 2441745 is direction-reversed despite correct from/to tags. Official full-GPX extraction can measure about 8.51 km while OSM raw members measure about 9.01 km. Draw by official identity and current shared-node topology, not raw relation order.

facilities.name: Early-stage firepit / Eldplatsen
facilities.description: Mapped early-stage firepit/rest context. Not an official water, shelter, or resupply point; use only if local signs and current fire rules allow.

facilities.name: Spring-side small tent/rest area
facilities.description: Small tent/rest option near the official spring, with room for a couple of tents according to official text. Verify ground and leave no trace.

facilities.name: Spring west of Järna
facilities.description: Official natural spring after about 5 km, about 100 m from the trail. Seasonal/reliability caveat: reported dry in Sep 2024, flowing in Oct 2024 and May 2025. Treat/filter and carry backup.

facilities.name: Sjuenda Kronopark mine-hole warning
facilities.description: Hazard zone: the forest/mining area has over 200 old mine holes, many unprotected, across a broad historic ore field. Stay on marked trail and use signed boards for history context.

facilities.name: Järna gruvor information board
facilities.description: Mining-history information board in the Järna gruvor/Tunnelgruvan cluster. Look-but-do-not-disturb heritage; mine holes can be dangerous and protected by heritage rules.

facilities.name: Tunnelgruvan
facilities.description: Signed mining feature/horizontal shaft area. Visits are at own risk; Friluftsfrämjandet found it too wet to enter fully in September 2024, and wet/slippery/unsafe conditions can occur. Do not enter unsafe openings.

facilities.name: Jungfrugruvan
facilities.description: Signed mine-history point in the old Järna mining area; stay out of unprotected holes.

facilities.name: Mossgruvan
facilities.description: Additional mapped mine-history point in the Järna gruvor cluster. Treat as protected heritage and hazardous terrain; avoid unmarked openings.

facilities.name: Storgruvan
facilities.description: Signed mine-history point near the route; stay on safe ground around shafts and spoil heaps.

facilities.name: Mellanbygget tent/rest option
facilities.description: Good tent/rest option near the farther torp ruin according to official route text, but no water. Coordinate is SGU/route-context derived and should be field-verified.

facilities.name: Vattgruvan / Stage 12 join
facilities.description: OSM Stage 11/12 shared node, about 31 m from the official Stage 12 start coordinate. Clip Stage 11 here; Stora Kobäcken is Stage 12 continuation.

facilities.name: Vattgruvan / Vattgruvsmossen parking
facilities.description: Stage-end access and reserve parking; official steward note says good parking up to 72 h where signed, OSM maps a small lot, and Naturkartan photo context suggests more spaces. Länsstyrelsen warns some access-road sections remain poor. Check signs and drive carefully.

facilities.name: Vattgruvan end toilet
facilities.description: Likely accessible toilet by the stage end/parking: mapped in OSM/Naturkartan/Vindskyddskartan and reported in a 2026-04-26 Sörmlandsleden comment. Still verify locally because not every official facility list is consistent.

facilities.name: Vattgruvsmossen entrance picnic/info
facilities.description: Reserve entrance picnic/information area near the stage end.

facilities.name: Vattgruvsmossen reserve rules
facilities.description: Reserve/Natura 2000 rule marker: dogs leashed, camping no more than two consecutive nights, fires only at designated places, no motor vehicles off roads, and no damaging or collecting living/dead wood, plants, invertebrates, mosses, lichens, wood fungi, rock, or soil.

facilities.name: Vattgruvsmossen wet footing warning
facilities.description: Bog/reserve approach can be wet with roots, stones, and boardwalks. Waterproof shoes are recommended after rain or outside dry summer conditions.

facilities.name: Kruthuset / Vattgruvorna heritage
facilities.description: Old stone powder-house and mining-remains area near Vattgruvan. Länsstyrelsen notes eight deep shafts and Vattgruvan reaching just over 100 m down.

facilities.name: Almviks Gård side service
facilities.description: Off-route bakery/farm-service context northeast of Vattgruvan. Verify opening hours and access; do not treat as a guaranteed Stage 11 service.

facilities.name: Almviks Gård mapped water point
facilities.description: OSM-mapped off-route drinking-water point. Low confidence for hikers; verify locally before relying on it.

facilities.name: Hunting season awareness
facilities.description: Hiking is not forbidden during hunting, but during active hunting periods, especially from the large moose hunt starting 8 October, watch for signs, many parked cars, or local notices and choose another area if hunting appears active.

facilities.name: Sjundareviret wolf context
facilities.description: Soft wildlife context from local hiking reports in the wider Mölnbo/Sjundareviret area. Not a danger alert by itself, but keep dogs leashed and secure food if overnighting on continuations.

facilities.name: Stora Kobäcken shelter (stage 12 continuation)
facilities.description: Shelter about 200-300 m beyond the stage end on stage 12. Naturkartan/Vindskyddskartan describe shelter, grill/fireplace, benches, boardwalk to water, roughly 4 sleeping places, tent space, nearby parking/toilet context, and unknown-quality water. Recent reports mention recent renovation, good tent/hammock options, flat tent space, blueberries, and stony ground near the shelter. Useful for overnight planning, but not core stage 11.

facilities.name: Stora Kobäcken fireplace (stage 12 continuation)
facilities.description: Designated fireplace at Stora Kobäcken. Bring your own wood or charcoal; no supplied firewood should be assumed, Naturkartan explicitly says bring your own, and current fire bans override use.

facilities.name: Stora Kobäcken natural water (stage 12 continuation)
facilities.description: Surface water by the adjacent continuation shelter area; quality is unknown and not a drinking tap. Treat/filter/boil if used.
